fields.text: What is the sum of the interior angles of a heptagon (7 sides)?
fields.explanation: The interior angles of an n-sided polygon add up to (n − 2) × 180°, so a heptagon has (7 − 2) × 180° = 900°.
fields.explanationTl: Ang sum ng interior angles ng polygon ay (n − 2) × 180°. Sa heptagon: (7 − 2) × 180° = 900°.
fields.stepsTl:
1. Gamitin ang formula: sum = (n − 2) × 180°.
2. n = 7, kaya n − 2 = 5.

fields.hint: A polygon can be split into triangles from one corner; count the triangles.

fields.whyB: 1,080° is (8 − 2) × 180°, the octagon's total.
fields.whyD: 1,260° is 7 × 180°; you forgot to subtract 2 from the number of sides.

fields.whyC: 30 ignores the extra 30 minutes and divides by 1 hour only.
fields.whyD: 15 divides by 2 hours; 1 h 30 min is 1.5 h, not 2 h.

fields.text: Lito saves ₱75 every week. Counting a year as 52 weeks, how much does he save in one year?

1. Total = weekly savings × number of weeks.
2. ₱75 × 52 = ₱75 × 50 + ₱75 × 2 = ₱3,750 + ₱150.
3. Total = ₱3,900.
fields.stepsTl:
1. Total = ipon kada linggo × bilang ng linggo.
2. ₱75 × 52 = ₱75 × 50 + ₱75 × 2 = ₱3,750 + ₱150.
3. Total = ₱3,900.
fields.hint: Multiply the weekly amount by the number of weeks. Break 52 into 50 + 2 to make it easy.
fields.hintTl: I-multiply ang weekly na ipon sa bilang ng weeks. Hatiin ang 52 sa 50 + 2 para madali.
fields.whyA: ₱3,600 uses 48 weeks (4 weeks × 12 months); the stem says 52 weeks.
fields.whyC: ₱900 is ₱75 × 12, as if he saved once a month.
fields.whyD: ₱3,975 uses 53 weeks; the stem says 52.

fields.whyC: 1 hour halves the time because the machines doubled, but the products doubled too.
fields.whyD: 3 hours has no basis; each machine still takes 2 hours per product.

fields.text: If 6 workers build 6 walls in 6 days, how many days will 3 workers take to build 6 walls?
fields.explanation: Each worker builds 1 wall in 6 days. 3 workers build 3 walls every 6 days, so 6 walls take 2 × 6 = 12 days.
fields.explanationTl: Bawat worker ay 1 wall sa 6 days. Ang 3 workers ay 3 walls kada 6 days, kaya ang 6 walls ay 12 days.
fields.steps:
1. 1 worker builds 1 wall in 6 days.
2. 3 workers build 3 walls in 6 days.
3. 6 walls is twice as many: 2 × 6 = 12 days.
fields.stepsTl:
1. 1 worker = 1 wall sa 6 days.
2. 3 workers = 3 walls sa 6 days.
3. Doble ang walls (6), kaya 2 × 6 = 12 days.
fields.hintTl: Alamin muna ang kaya ng ISANG tao kada oras o araw.
fields.whyA: 6 days is the time for 3 workers to build 3 walls; here they must build 6.
fields.whyB: 3 days halves the time, but fewer workers means MORE time, not less.
fields.whyD: 9 days adds only half again; with half the workers and the same walls, the time doubles.
